title: HMCue
description: A quality-of-life mod for HydronixMC that improves visuals, performance, and overall gameplay experience.
body:
HMCue is a quality-of-life mod created for HydronixMC.
It improves various graphical elements, such as smooth texture fading and hiding player name tags under specific conditions.
Each feature can be enabled or disabled individually through the Mod Menu.

## Current Features
### Player Name Tag Hiding

This feature hides player name tags when a player is behind a wall or riding an entity.

### Optimized Model Loading

This feature works especially well in combination with our server.
Normally, entities are loaded within a fixed radius around the player. With this feature, the server can detect the player's location and dynamically load or unload certain entities for that player, which can improve FPS and overall performance.

### Smooth Texture Fading

This feature improves how Minecraft handles alpha cut-outs in transparent textures.
In vanilla Minecraft, transparent textures often have a harsh edge due to a high alpha cut-out threshold. This feature replaces that effect with a smoother alpha fade for a cleaner and more natural look. (See screenshots)
